item1.text: P-RA.4 predicted that A1's poisoning sets would move the realigned FPR (poisoned over clean) by x2 or more (D-241 (3)'s cut) at some rho <= 1% in at least 80% of the cells (D-418 (5)'s rule; D-423 (5) applies it to the LoRA and Procrustes units); it FAILED in all six arms (#108, #112, #116, #120, #124, #128), the ridge (D-418) and orthogonal Procrustes (D-423) maps, each on Phase 1, Phase 2 and LoRA. item4.sentence: WHAT EACH MEASURES (the author's decision of 2026-10-18, D-503 (4)): C4.10 measures the repair, the realised FPR/target at the frozen threshold after the realignment fitted on R_same against the target (one value per pair, 9 pairs per arm), while C2.11 measures the two-moment model, its predicted FPR/target against the realised FPR/target (one value per pair and fit pool, R_same, R_fresh and 1% traffic, 27 cells per arm), so C4.10's x1.5 is a distance from the target and C2.11's is a prediction error.
